description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/goal-target-inference.ts, add a deterministic code-search route following the existing deterministicEnvGateRoute and deterministicCompositionAsk pattern in that file. When a goal asks to search the codebase, find what creates/defines a symbol, find where something is configured, or root-cause a named symbol or error string — and the goal contains no persist-write clause (_COMPOSITION_WRITE_CLAUSE) — return a GoalTargetDecision targeting code-search shapes (codeSearchResult, or code_find_function / source_code when advertised in knownShapes) at moderate confidence. Guard it so it only fires when those shapes are advertised in knownShapes and it must NOT preempt the registry-count-to-shellResult route or the composition-write route. This fixes the observed misrouting where a goal saying 'search the codebase for what creates exec_test_1' was inferred as execution_trace/trace_search (a trace-store query) instead of a code search.
